key_facts: UPDATED Thu Sep 3 (T+1d to Fri Sep 4 FAO FFPI release; SUBMITTED — Sugar 0.49->0.56 [+0.07], Cereals 0.46->0.40 [-0.06], Vegetable Oils 0.035->0.025 [-0.01], Dairy 0.01, Meat 0.005; sum=1.000): Newly retrieved official July 2026 FAO & World Bank sugar benchmarks pin the previously uncertain July sugar base tightly, strengthening Sugar's edge over Cereals. (1) SUGAR (0.56, +0.07): Official July 2026 FAO Sugar Price Index = 95.0 points (+5.1 pts / +5.6% from June's 89.9; -8.3 pts / -8.0% from July 2025's 103.3, per MarketScreener & JIRCAS Aug 7/14), corroborated by World Bank Pink Sheet July 2026 global sugar = $0.34/kg (kompas.id Aug 8; exact $0.335-$0.3449/kg = 15.20-15.64 c/lb). With FAO's 2014-2016 ISA base (~16.05-16.20 c/lb, cross-checked against WB 2025 avg $0.37/kg = 16.78 c/lb), July 2026 ISA daily price is pinned tightly at ~15.25-15.40 c/lb (center 15.32 c/lb), ruling out the feared >15.6 c/lb July base. Against ~15.32 c/lb, August's 21-day ICE #11 raw sugar avg (~16.45-16.60 c/lb; confirmed Aug 24-31 6-day avg 17.58 c/lb, Aug 31 close 17.81 c/lb) tracks ~+7.4% to +8.3% MoM (with minor upside if ISA reflects Oct26-Mar27 contango). (2) CEREALS (0.40, -0.06): Weighted ~44% IGC Wheat (~+7.2-7.7% incl. FOB basis) + ~37% IGC Maize/Coarse (~+8.4-8.8%) + ~19% low-vol FAO Rice (~+0.5-0.8%) tracks ~+6.5% to +7.0% MoM, structurally held ~0.8-1.0pp behind Sugar by the ~19% rice drag, though physical Black Sea/EU FOB wheat & French corn outperformance could still push Cereals to ~+8% (~40% win prob). (3) VEG OILS (0.025), DAIRY (0.01), MEAT (0.005) remain deep tails against a ~+7.5% hurdle.
